card.statement:
Note that the subscript “ $R$ ” does not have the same meaning in the notation “ $\mathcal{D}_{x,R}$ ” and “ $X_{R}$,” in that it is not true that $\mathcal{D}_{x,R}\cong\mathcal{D}_{x}\otimes_{\mathrm{Spec}(\mathbf{C})}\mathrm{Spec}(R)$.

The following proposition gives a first description of $\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G,x}$ in terms of moduli of bundles on $X$.
card.label: Remark 7.2

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
